crime: Before {WITCH_NAME} was imprisoned, her father died during an ordinary meal. He had shown no illness, no warning, and no change in routine. Since then, whenever a place, person, or subject gives her an unexpected shock, she changes her route.

{WITCH_NAME} shares a cell with another girl. Before the cell is locked each night, her cellmate waits while {WITCH_NAME} checks the bunks and floor in the same order. {WITCH_NAME} then listens to the cellmate recount her day until the cellmate falls asleep.

One night, that routine ends normally. After a long silence, the sleeping cellmate sits up without a sound and closes both hands around {WITCH_NAME}'s throat. {WITCH_NAME} fights free. Only then does the cellmate wake, with no memory of the attack. The bruises on {WITCH_NAME}'s throat remain visible the next day.

{WITCH_NAME} asks the warden for another cell, but the warden refuses because assignments are fixed. The cellmate is horrified but cannot promise that the attack will not happen again. Before the next cell lock, {WITCH_NAME} asks the cellmate to talk during the courtyard walk. The cellmate agrees only after a third girl promises to meet them both at the courtyard fountain so that neither will face the other alone.

Before the meeting, {WITCH_NAME} presses her palm to the direct path beside a courtyard tree and leaves a ward there. She and the cellmate enter the courtyard first. Following them toward the fountain, the third girl sees the pair ahead and notices that the earlier throat bruises are still visible. The pair stop out of sight behind the tree.

The third girl heads down the direct path to the fountain. The ward turns her onto the other existing route, and the choice feels ordinary. The third girl waits at the fountain for the pair to join her.
Behind the tree, {WITCH_NAME} strangles the cellmate. Once the cellmate stops moving, {WITCH_NAME} ends the ward and calls the third girl back from the fountain.

The path is direct again when the third girl returns and finds {WITCH_NAME} beside the body. {WITCH_NAME} says the cellmate closed both hands around her bruised throat again and that she killed the cellmate to break the grip. The third girl sees no new redness or broken skin beyond the bruises visible before the meeting.

The third girl later remembers reaching the fountain from the wrong side on the way there. The third girl had seen the pair go behind the tree before the detour. The caster could place the ward only by pressing a palm to that distant path, so it had been prepared before the sudden attack {WITCH_NAME} later claimed.

The old bruises made self-defense seem credible at first. The absence of fresh marks on her throat disproves the alleged second grip, while the prepared ward shows that {WITCH_NAME} removed the agreed safety witness in advance. Together, they expose a planned killing.
fields.epitaph: Every way around danger closed in at once.
execution: A circular iron cage descends around her and stops.

Without warning, the cage contracts from every side at once. The bars pin her upper arms against her ribs and press into her chest and back. The cage keeps closing until her ribs and spine break and her chest collapses. The bars remain locked around her until her chest stops moving.

magic.name: Detour Ward
magic.text: She can ward a short stretch of ground, making anyone who would cross it take another route.
